/** 🧰️ Shared kit of the presence-client suites (`🚪️presence-room`, `🧭️presence-places-and-rooms`, `🖱️pointer-and-focus`, `🪟️presence-screens`): the sockets the test plays the proctor for, and the course, roster and snapshot fixtures. The suites together check shared presence in the web client (design §15–§17).
 *
 * @see ../🧫️fixtures/📡️presence-client/🔣️.json
 * @see ../../🎯️targets/⚛️react/🔨️modules/👥️presence/🟦️.tsx
 */

/** 🚪️ The presence room in the web client (design §15): joining with the presence subprotocol, rendering its batches, leaving, throttling the frames it sends — with `lodash`'s `throttle` (leading and trailing edge) as the third-party oracle — rejoining after a lost socket and watching other rooms read-only.
 *
 * @see ../🧰️presence-client-kit/🟦️.tsx — the sockets and fixtures
 * @see ../🧫️fixtures/📡️presence-client/🔣️.json
 * @see ../../🎯️targets/⚛️react/🔨️modules/👥️presence/🟦️.tsx
 */

/** 🧭️ The places and rooms of presence (design §16): the rooms a place joins (home watching every page behind the cards and every thinking room), the pointer and keyboard focus it shares there, the drafts it shares at most twice a second — with `lodash`'s `throttle` as the third-party oracle — and the item a learner drags; the place and watch vectors are shared JSON.
 *
 * @see ../🧰️presence-client-kit/🟦️.tsx — the sockets and fixtures
 * @see ../🧫️fixtures/📡️presence-client/🔣️.json
 * @see ../../🎯️targets/⚛️react/🔨️modules/👥️presence/🟦️.tsx
 */

/** 🖱️ The pointer, keyboard focus and drag the client shares (design §16) — measured on the nearest anchor, an item or a card, also while pressed, and over every viewport gap, with `lodash`'s `clamp` as the third-party oracle of the cursor's fraction; the cursor vectors are shared JSON.
 *
 * @see ../🧰️presence-client-kit/🟦️.tsx — the sockets and fixtures
 * @see ../🧫️fixtures/📡️presence-client/🔣️.json
 * @see ../../🎯️targets/⚛️react/🔨️modules/👥️presence/🟦️.tsx
 */

/** 🪟️ How the screens show the others (design §17): card activity, cursors and focus frames on their anchors, name labels and colours, the learner card, the quiz cards and the leaderboard, inside the pages behind the cards too; the activity vectors are shared JSON.
 *
 * @see ../🧰️presence-client-kit/🟦️.tsx — the sockets and fixtures
 * @see ../🧫️fixtures/📡️presence-client/🔣️.json
 * @see ../../🎯️targets/⚛️react/🔨️modules/👥️presence/🟦️.tsx
 */
